settings.desc_user_preset: Save, switch, and share conversion + CSS style bundles (SMTP credentials and local paths are excluded)
settings.msg_preset_restored: Preset '{name}' restored to default and applied.
settings.desc_device_profile: Ready-made presets for format, screen resolution, DPI, and footnotes for popular e-readers and PDF A5
settings.desc_screen_size: Resolution (width × height in px) and DPI — used for covers, image scaling, and PDF page size
settings.desc_footnotes_mode: Linked sections, popup footnotes (Kindle / Kobo / EPUB3), or renumbered popups (best for PDF)
settings.desc_soft_hyphen: Insert soft hyphens (\u00AD) inside words for readers without built-in hyphenation
settings.desc_dropcaps: Enable or disable drop-cap styling at chapter openings in fb2cng
settings.desc_fn_translit: Convert non-Latin characters in the output filename to Latin
settings.desc_meta_translit: Convert book title and author names in exported metadata to Latin
settings.desc_title_mode: Controls how the book title appears in your e-reader library (metainformation.title_template)
settings.desc_tt_speech: Normalize leading dialogue hyphens to em-dash (text_transformations.speech)
settings.desc_annotation_enable: Include a dedicated book annotation section (document.annotation.enable)
settings.desc_toc_placement: Placement of the generated visible TOC page (document.toc_page.placement)
settings.desc_open_from_cover: Start reading at the cover page instead of the body text (ignored on Kindle)
settings.desc_cover_generate: Generate a fallback cover when the FB2 has none (cover.generate)
settings.desc_no_cover: Build EPUB, KEPUB, and PDF without a cover page (ignored for Kindle formats)
settings.desc_format: Output file format when running the fb2cng converter
settings.desc_filename_mode: Default naming ((ABC - 01) Title) or custom visual builder using fb2cng tags
settings.desc_azw3_comp: Compression algorithm for native AZW3 format (no KindleGen required)
settings.desc_kfx_comp: Compression mode when converting to KFX and AZW8 formats
settings.desc_azw3_apnx: Generate companion .apnx page-number sidecar file next to AZW3 book
settings.desc_md_images: How images are rendered when converting to Markdown (MD)
settings.desc_workers: Number of parallel fb2cng worker processes for batch conversion
settings.desc_baseline_jpeg: Convert progressive and non-baseline JPEGs to baseline for readers with limited JPEG support
settings.desc_raster: Control raster illustration format independently of target book format
settings.desc_svg: When Off, KFX/AZW8 and PDF preserve supported SVG graphics and vignettes as vectors
settings.desc_trans: Fill transparent background with white. Leave Off for Kindle — handled automatically while preserving vector SVG
settings.desc_opt_img: Re-encode JPEG above quality threshold and apply maximum PNG compression (except PDF)
settings.desc_save_mode: By default, converted files are saved next to the source FB2
settings.desc_custom_dir: All converted files will be placed in this directory
settings.desc_language: Select application language (external files in the locales folder)
settings.desc_email_auto: When enabled and SMTP settings are filled, converted files are emailed to the target address
settings.desc_smtp: SMTP server address, port (usually 465 for SSL or 587 for STARTTLS), and encryption
settings.desc_creds: Username and password (or app password) for mail server authentication
settings.desc_addrs: Target e-mail is required for auto-send; sender defaults to SMTP username
settings.desc_email_test: Send a short test email without running conversion
settings.email_test_incomplete: Please fill in SMTP host, port, sender (or username), and recipient address.
settings.email_test_body:
This is a test email from {app} v{ver}.
Connection to {host}:{port} works properly.
